appearance_facts.fact: The chart title is 'Decreasing Number of New Tourists in Town Z from 1880 to 1891'.
The y-axis is labeled 'Number of Tourists' with tick marks at 0, 500, 1000, 1500, 2000, 2500, and 3000.
The x-axis is labeled 'Year' with ticks for years 1880 through 1891.
A single blue line plots the number of new tourists over time.
The line begins at the year 1880, corresponding to 1000 tourists on the y-axis.
The line peaks at the year 1890, corresponding to 3000 tourists on the y-axis.
The line ends at the year 1891, corresponding to approximately 2900 tourists on the y-axis.
The line reaches approximately 2700 tourists in the year 1887.
